equipment_type: VAV box controller (compact, built-in damper drive)
applies_to: TROX VAV terminal units fitted with the BM0-D8 compact control component (LMV/NMV-D3-M/B-X TR actuators).
summary: BM0-D8 is a compact VAV actuator-controller TROX fits to its VAV terminal units. It ships in Modbus RTU mode and can be switched to BACnet MS/TP with a service tool. The BACnet object list has 23 objects: relative setpoint (AO 1), override (MO 1), airflow and damper readings, min/max limits, a bus watchdog and status objects.
notes: The PICS names the product "VAV Compact ..MV-D3-M/B-X"; the object list matches the Belimo VAV-Compact (MOD) object numbering, so it shares firmware with that Belimo product.
The unit leaves the factory in Modbus RTU mode; switch it to BACnet MS/TP with a service tool before integrating.
AO 1 and MO 1 are commandable (priority array).
Only the inactive state texts are printed for the BIs.
The airflow unit for AI 19 and AV 104 follows MV 121 UnitSelFlow (default m³/h).

integration.summary: Switch the unit to BACnet MS/TP, keep MV 122 SpSource at Bus, and write the setpoint to AO 1 SpRel (0-100 % between qvmin and qvmax); MO 1 Override forces open/closed/qvmin/qvmid/qvmax. Read AI 10 or AI 19 for airflow, AI 1 for damper position and BI 101 for faults. Turn on AV 130 Bus Watchdog if the unit should fall back when the BMS stops writing.

minimum_points.name: SpRel
minimum_points.why: Airflow setpoint between Min. and Max.

integration.enable: MV 122 SpSource selects the setpoint source: 2 = Bus (factory setting), 1 = Analogue, in which case AO 1 goes out of service.
integration.heartbeat: AV 130 Bus Watchdog (0-3600 s, factory 0 = off). When set, writes to AO 1 SpRel or MO 1 Override reset the timer; if it expires the AO 1 Relinquish_Default applies (factory 0 = qvmin) and MI 110 StatusDevice shows bus failure. In hybrid mode only MO 1 writes are monitored.
setup: Factory default is Modbus RTU; change to BACnet MS/TP with a service tool (display, adjustment device or PC software).
Quick addressing via the [Address] push-button is described in the manual.
gotchas: With AV 130 = 0 (factory) there is no bus-failure fallback.
Min. (AV 97) must stay below Max. (AV 98); qvmax range is 20-100 % of nominal.
